_comment: Land clearing and acquisition (§5.1b, §5.3), Phase 1 checkpoint 1d. All numbers are [TWEAK] placeholders, not historical facts. Prices are in MODERN dollars per 10 m x 10 m tile (1/40 acre) and are multiplied by the era's price_multiplier (eras.json) at the time of the action.

clearing._comment: Clearing turns university-owned forest into cleared land (pasture). Each order is worked by its own crew; winter (December-February) is slower.

purchase._comment: Buying land next to university land. Town land (inside the platted town) costs far more and hurts town relations (§5.3); the penalty is only recorded until the Town Relations score exists (Phase 2).

town_growth._comment: The town grows on its own by the placeholder rules in map/land_history.json; changes are applied once a month to land the university doesn't own.
